_comment: AWI ENGINE - TUTORIAL COMPLETO - Demonstra todos os recursos da engine em um único arquivo

metadata.title: AwiOS Tutorial
metadata.description: Tutorial completo: mensagens, escolhas, efeitos, mídia, condições e stats
metadata.author: AwiOS Team

start.text: 🚀 Welcome to the complete AwiOS tutorial!

intro_controls.text:
🎮 CONTROLS:
• Click/ENTER/SPACE: Advance
• Right-click/R/BACKSPACE: Go back
• S key: Skip Mode
• T key: Toggle text speed
• Keys 1,2,3: Quick choice selection

intro_advance.text: Try clicking or pressing ENTER to advance through messages...

nodes._comment_choices: === SEÇÃO 2: SISTEMA DE ESCOLHAS E EFEITOS ===

first_choice.text: Let's start with a simple choice. What's your favorite color?

choice_blue.text: Blue! A classic and reliable choice. 💙

choice_red.text: Red! Full of energy and passion! ❤️

choice_green.text: Green! My favorite color too! We have a lot in common! 💚

explain_stats.text:
📊 Look at the bottom bar! Your stats changed based on your choice:
• ❤️ Affection: relationship level
• ⭐ Points: general score
• 🤝 Trust: trust level
• 💀 Corruption: dark choices

effects_demo.text: Let's test positive and negative effects:

kind_result.text: How sweet! Kind choices increase affection and points! 💕

neutral_result.text: Hmm... negative choices can hurt relationships. But you can go back!

dark_result.text: Interesting... dark choices might give more points, but have consequences! ⚠️

show_image.text: Here's an example image you can tap to view full screen:

show_second_image.text: Here's another image (tap to view full screen). Videos and GIFs work the same way!

settings_info.text:
📱 Available settings:
• Language (English/Portuguese)
• Text speed (affects display speed)
• Auto-save toggle
• Notifications control
• Gallery management
• Progress reset

Try changing settings and see the effects!

meet_sarah.text: Hi! I'm Sarah. I'll help demonstrate how conditions work in the engine!

condition_test.text: Let's test this! Make a choice that will affect the next scene:

trust_sarah.text: Thank you for trusting me! This will be important later...

cautious_sarah.text: I understand your caution. Trust must be earned...

trusted_path.text: Since you trust me, I can share a secret: conditions can create completely different story branches! 🔓

untrusted_path.text: I wish I could tell you more, but trust is important for deeper conversations... 🔒

explain_conditions.text: 💡 Did you see? Based on your trust level, Sarah reacted differently! Conditions can check any stat: affection >= 10, points < 50, corruption > 0, etc.

advanced_choice.text: Let's test a complex scenario with multiple effects and conditions:

choices.text: Take the heroic path 🦸‍♀️ [High risk, high reward]
Choose the safe path 🛡️ [Low risk, moderate reward]
Take the dark path 😈 [Corruption, but powerful]

heroic_path.text: Brave choice! Heroes often face the greatest challenges but reap the greatest rewards! ⭐

safe_path.text: Wisdom is knowing when to be cautious. Sometimes the safe path is the right path! 🛡️

dark_path.text: Power comes with a price. The dark path offers strength, but at what cost? ⚠️

high_score_ending.text: 🏆 EXCELLENT! You scored 30+ points! You've mastered the AwiOS tutorial!

normal_ending.text: Good job completing the tutorial! There's always room to explore different paths and choices.

tutorial_complete.text:
🎯 Tutorial Complete!

✅ You learned:
• Message system with text speed control
• Choices & stat effects (❤️ Affection, ⭐ Points, 🤝 Trust, 💀 Corruption)
• Images, videos & GIFs with full-screen viewing
• Settings system (Language, Speed, Notifications)
• Conditional story branching

Now you're ready to explore AwiOS!

final_tips.text:
💡 Pro Tips:
• Check Settings to customize your experience
• Images and videos unlock automatically in Gallery
• Tap media to view full screen
• Stats influence story paths
• Try different choices to see all outcomes!
